notes_for_editor: The register gives no build date and no staffing or access information. The 2022 register visit calls the site an active MFC location, while the 2020 Commercial Dispatch article (archived copy; the original URL returns 410 Gone) says one county tower is idle and another is a radio tower. The article does not name which tower is the register's Oktibbeha tower, and the register does not say which tower the visit covered, so the match is unconfirmed. The story reports both accounts and does not pick one. Height converted from 100 ft. Searches found no construction or retirement dates for this tower. Searches used: 1 WebSearch.
